title: The First Night
pages:
The first night I had nothing. A tree, a stone, and the dark coming in.

I took the wood first, because wood is the only thing that asks nothing of you. Then the stone, then the black seams, then the red rock.

By the time I had iron in my hands, the night had sent its one visitor to the mouth of the cave. It was only a zombie. I do not know why I had been so afraid.
